question: What are the three sacraments of initiation into the Catholic Church?

choices.D: Baptism, Eucharist, and Anointing of the Sick

teaching.title: Sacraments of Initiation
teaching.body: The three sacraments of Christian initiation are Baptism (which removes original sin and incorporates one into the Body of Christ), Confirmation (which seals and strengthens the baptismal grace through the Holy Spirit), and Eucharist (which nourishes and sustains the Christian life). Baptism is the gateway to the other sacraments. In the Eastern rites and for adult converts in the RCIA, all three are typically received together.
